tips: Weekdays (Tuesday–Friday): Generally moderate crowds. The average waiting time for standard Sarvadarshanam (free darshan) ranges between 20 to 30 minutes.
Weekends (Saturday & Sunday): The wait times usually increase to 40 to 60 minutes.
Mondays: Being a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, Mondays are considered highly auspicious. Crowds spike drastically, and wait times can stretch to 1 to 2 hours.
Festivals & Holidays: Peak congestion occurs during Maha Shivaratri, Shravana Masam, Kartika Masam, and long holiday weekends. During these peak periods, wait times often exceed 2 to 3 hours.
